description:
What this does. When somebody leaves, open their employee page and use Clinic › Deactivate from Cova. That tells the clinic they are no longer covered, so they are not treated by mistake and you are not billed for it.

If they need a final health check on the way out, tick the box for it and that check is booked at the same time.
name: Deactivate an Employee from Cova
title: Sign off someone who has left
